notes.title: City Z 1.0.6 update
notes.notes:
Hi gam@rs! ːz_antidoteː
A new update is available for City Z. 

Changelog: 
- [BUG] Fix player not moving on some computers.
- [Survival] Player announce next wave 3 sec before zombies spawn.
- [Survival] Fix weapons spawning under vehicles.
- [Survival] Fix zombies disappearing in map.
- [VR] Fix objects transparency when moving camera near buildings.
- [Survival] Duplicate weapon's drop when reaching bosses.

Thank you soo much for your support. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: City Z 1.0.5 update
notes.notes:
Hi gam@rs!
A new update is available for City Z. 

Changelog: 
- Working HTC Vive compatibility (at last ːsteamhappyː).
- Add controller's vibration when shooting. (Can be disabled in settings).
- Change ammunitions behaviour to avoid losing ammos when reloading before current clip was empty.
- Update water graphics.

Thank you soo much for your support.

notes.title: City Z 1.0.2 update (VR)
notes.notes:
A new update is available for City Z. It is a VR update that fix some issues with VR headsets.

Changelog:
- New controls to be able to look to the south or to the north.
- Better HTC Vive camera position.
- Add achievement unlock notification inside the game.

Thank you soo much for your support.
